exposure: electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) use during pregnancy
cohort: The study participants were 42,827 women from the 2016-2018 Pregnancy Risk Assessment and Monitoring System.
finding: Prenatal exposure to electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) is negatively associated with breastfeeding duration, independent of potential confounders.
cross-section timing: Postpartum (data collected 2-6 months after birth via PRAMS)
